Overview.Name: Rambabu N
Overview.Goal: Looking better (appearance), feeling energetic & confident, preventing/reversing health issues, mental wellbeing & stress reduction

Meal_1_Breakfast: 3 whole eggs pan fried in butter + 1 bowl curd
OR Omelette with onions and tomatoes + 1  banana
Meal_2_Lunch: Chicken curry (home made) + 1 cup white rice + cooked vegetables
OR Fish fry (shallow pan fried) + 1 cup rice + cucumber
OR Paneer curry + 1 cup rice + green vegetables
OR Boiled eggs (2-3) + mix veg + small bowl curd
Meal_3_Dinner: Grilled or pan fried fish + vegetables
OR Chicken or egg curry + small rice + salad
Snack_Optional_Light: OR Buttermilk with small piece of fruit

Notes_and_Tips: Prioritise eggs, fish, chicken, paneer and curd in every meal for lean muscle gain support.
Limit fried, bakery, and snack foods that trigger cravings. Choose roasted or pan fried instead.
Increase steps to 7,000 per day gradually for better digestion and energy.
Manage thyroid health by improving sleep. Target minimum 7 hours instead of less than 6.
For appearance goals: keep meals simple and repeatable to stay consistent.
If you feel hunger between meals, increase protein quantity instead of adding carbs.
Savory craving strategy: have boiled eggs, curd or makhana ready at home.
Drink 2.5-3L water daily for proper hydration and metabolism support.
